purpose: Inspect one product-level recall route without downloading the historical CPSC export.

record.title: Char-Broil Recalls Bistro Pro Electric Grills Due to Risk of Electric Shock
record.units: About 10,605 in the United States; 342 sold in Canada
record.hazard: Grounding wire for the heating element can disconnect and lose fault protection, posing an electric-shock hazard.
record.remedy_summary: Stop use; register for a repair kit and instructions; complete the repair; affix the supplied label; submit photo documentation of the completed repair to receive a digital $25 gift card.

boundary: This is one live API response, not a recall prevalence estimate, exposed-household denominator, remedy-completion rate, or verified consumer receipt. CPSC recall records and remedy language can change; the derived sample should be rechecked before quantitative use.
